content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define cloning and explain how clones are produced naturally and artificially
Describe the process of adult cell cloning (somatic cell nuclear transfer)
Explain the uses of cloning in animals and plants
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of cloning

is an organism that is genetically identical to another organism. Cloning occurs naturally in some organisms and can also be done artificially. While cloning offers potential benefits in medicine and agriculture, it also raises significant ethical questions.
